svg.title: How the trilateration solver works
svg.desc: Animation of one solve with five anchors: distance circles, the closed-form starting point, 4 Levenberg-Marquardt steps, a mirror check that restarts from the reflected point and converges to a worse fit, and the final estimate (23.78, 27.05) with its 95% confidence region.
svg.text: Each anchor measures its distance to the unknown position
1. A closed-form linear estimate gives the starting point
2. Levenberg-Marquardt steps to the nearest best fit
3. Mirror check: restart from the reflected point
4. Keep the better fit: residual cost 9 beats 1638
The estimate, with its 95% confidence region
